# Apex Wallet
Apex Wallet is a non-custodial crypto wallet software application. Public legal and login pages.

Canonical: https://apexwallet.app

/login - Public login and wallet access page
/coming-soon - Public placeholder page for unreleased features
/legal/terms - Terms of Service (non-custodial software; not a bank, exchange, or regulated financial provider)
/legal/privacy - Privacy Policy (minimal data; no identity verification)
/legal/risk-disclosure - Risk Disclosure Statement (self-custody and crypto risks)
